[10] (ran5_cr_chunks R5-246867, sim=0.4256)
Title: Addition of TT analysis for NR-U L1-RSRP measurement reporting tests Reason for change: During RAN5#103, R5-243743r1 was provisionally agreed with final Tdoc R5-244000. However, that same final Tdoc was also assigned to another CR. To resolve this, another final Tdoc was issued, R5-244021. This CR was missed during implementation of TS 38.903 after RAN5#103. This CR resubmits R5-244021, and in addition adds test cases 13.3.3.1 and 13.3.3.2, which share similar TT analysis to those agreed in R5-244021. Summary of change: Resubmission of R5-244021 including TT analysis for test cases 10.4.3.1, 10.4.3.2, 10.4.3.3, 10.4.3.4, 11.5.4.1, 11.5.4.2, 11.5.4.3, 11.5.4.4. Added test tolerance analysis for test cases 13.3.3.1 and 13.3.3.2. Updated Table 8-4 for all referenced test cases. Consequ
